## `neuro.map.set`

Instance method on `Map.prototype`.

> Adds a new element with a specified key and value to the Map. If an element with the same key already exists, the element will be updated.

## Signatures

```ts
set(input: { map: <receiver>; key: K; value: V; prompt?: string }): Promise<Map<K, V>>
```

The `prompt` field is optional. When omitted (or set to an empty string)
the wrapper falls back to the native `Map.prototype.set` and returns a
resolved Promise without contacting the LLM. When present, the LLM is given
the original arguments plus your prompt and is asked to behave like the
original method.
